text: Joshua, Joshua, Jipp—Jopp—what was his name?” “You’re wrong!” said the young man. “My name is Donald Farfrae. It is true I am in the corren trade—but I have replied to no advertisement, and arranged to see no one. I am on my way to Bristol—from there to the other side of the warrld, to try my fortune in the great wheat-growing districts of the West! I have some inventions useful to the trade, and there is no scope for developing them heere.” “To America—well, well,” said Henchard, in a tone of disappointment, so strong as to make itself felt like a damp atmosphere.
